[Thinking]
**Designing car rental API endpoints**

The user is asking for REST API endpoints for a business in Italian, which suggests they want a structured design for a car rental service. I’ll consider core resources like cars, locations, reservations, customers, payments, pricing, and so on. I need to provide concise yet complete endpoints with methods, parameters, request/response examples, roles, and authentication details. Including status codes and maybe optional webhooks will also be important to cover in my response. Let’s keep formatting minimal.**Structuring car rental API endpoints**

I’m planning to outline API endpoints for a car rental service. I'll cover authentication, user management, vehicle details, categories, locations, availability searches, pricing, reservations, extras, payments, rentals, insurance, promotions, invoices, admin reports, error models, and pagination. It’s important to keep this concise while also incorporating elements like sample requests for availability searches and reservations. I also need to present this in Italian—let's ensure clarity and usability throughout!
[/Thinking]

Ecco una proposta di API REST per un servizio di car-rental. Versiona con /v1, usa JSON, usa header Idempotency-Key per operazioni sensibili, autenticazione Bearer JWT/OAuth2.

Autenticazione e utenti
- POST /v1/auth/register – Crea account cliente
- POST /v1/auth/login – Ottieni token
- POST /v1/auth/refresh – Refresh token
- POST /v1/auth/logout
- POST /v1/auth/forgot-password, POST /v1/auth/reset-password
- GET /v1/me – Profilo utente corrente
- PATCH /v1/me – Aggiorna profilo
- GET /v1/users – [Admin] Lista utenti
- GET /v1/users/{userId}, PATCH /v1/users/{userId}, DELETE /v1/users/{userId}

Sedi e flotta
- GET /v1/locations – Lista filiali (con orari, coordinate)
- GET /v1/locations/{locationId}
- GET /v1/locations/{locationId}/inventory – Veicoli disponibili per data/ora
- GET /v1/vehicle-classes – Segmenti/tipi (Mini, SUV, Premium…)
- GET /v1/vehicles – [Admin] Lista veicoli (filtri: classId, locationId, status)
- POST /v1/vehicles – [Admin] Crea veicolo
- GET /v1/vehicles/{vehicleId}
- PATCH /v1/vehicles/{vehicleId} – Stato (available, maintenance, retired), posizione
- POST /v1/vehicles/{vehicleId}/photos
- GET /v1/vehicles/{vehicleId}/maintenance, POST /v1/vehicles/{vehicleId}/maintenance

Ricerca disponibilità e tariffe
- GET /v1/availability
  Query: pickupLocationId, pickupAt (ISO), dropoffLocationId, dropoffAt, driversAge, classId?, transmission?, fuelPolicy?
- POST /v1/quotes – Calcola tariffa
  Body: pickup/dropoff, classId o vehicleId, extras[], promoCode?, driversAge
- GET /v1/quotes/{quoteId}

Prenotazioni
- POST /v1/reservations – Crea prenotazione da quote o parametri diretti
- GET /v1/reservations – Lista (filtri: status, userId, date range)
- GET /v1/reservations/{reservationId}
- PATCH /v1/reservations/{reservationId} – Modifiche (orari, location, extras)
- POST /v1/reservations/{reservationId}/confirm – Conferma (blocca tariffa, preaut)
- POST /v1/reservations/{reservationId}/cancel
- POST /v1/reservations/{reservationId}/apply-promo
- POST /v1/reservations/{reservationId}/attachments – Documenti (patente, ID)
Stati tipici: draft -> pending_payment -> confirmed -> picked_up -> returned -> canceled -> no_show

Noleggi (contratto di locazione)
- POST /v1/rentals – Avvia noleggio da reservationId (check-out)
- GET /v1/rentals – Lista
- GET /v1/rentals/{rentalId}
- POST /v1/rentals/{rentalId}/add-charges – Pedaggi, carburante, danni, extra giorni
- POST /v1/rentals/{rentalId}/swap-vehicle – Cambio veicolo
- POST /v1/rentals/{rentalId}/return – Check-in (km finali, livello carburante, danni)
- GET /v1/rentals/{rentalId}/agreement – PDF contratto

Pagamenti e fatture
- POST /v1/payment-methods – Salva metodo (tokenizzato)
- GET /v1/payment-methods
- DELETE /v1/payment-methods/{id}
- POST /v1/payments – Addebito o preaut
  Body: reservationId/rentalId, amount, currency, capture: true|false
- POST /v1/payments/{paymentId}/capture
- POST /v1/payments/{paymentId}/refund
- GET /v1/payments, GET /v1/payments/{paymentId}
- GET /v1/invoices – Lista fatture
- GET /v1/invoices/{invoiceId}, POST /v1/invoices/{invoiceId}/send

Prodotti accessori e coperture
- GET /v1/extras – Seggiolino, GPS, conducente aggiuntivo…
- GET /v1/protections – CDW, TP, SLI, franchigie
- GET /v1/promotions – Codici promo attivi
- POST /v1/promotions/validate – Verifica codice

Prezzi e regole
- GET /v1/rate-plans – Piani tariffari
- GET /v1/fees – Supplementi (one-way, fuori orario, underage)
- GET /v1/taxes – Imposte per località
- GET /v1/fuel-policies, GET /v1/mileage-policies

Report e amministrazione
- GET /v1/reports/utilization – Tasso utilizzo flotta
- GET /v1/reports/revenue – Ricavi per periodo/filiale
- GET /v1/reports/damages – Danni per veicolo
- GET /v1/audit-logs – Tracciamento azioni
- GET /v1/health – Health check

Webhook (per PSP, eventi di flotta)
- POST /v1/webhooks/payment – Eventi pagamento (succeeded, failed, disputed)
- POST /v1/webhooks/telematics – Chilometri, alert, posizione
- POST /v1/webhooks/reservations – created, canceled

Parametri comuni
- Paginazione: ?page, pageSize; ordinamento: ?sort=field,-field
- Filtri data ISO8601; importi in minor units; timezone esplicita
- ETag/If-Match per update ottimistico su risorse critiche
- Idempotency-Key per POST sensibili (payments, reservations)

Modelli dati essenziali
- Vehicle: id, vin, plate, classId, make, model, year, transmission, seats, fuel, locationId, status
- Quote: id, pickupAt, dropoffAt, classId/vehicleId, base, taxes, fees, extras[], total, currency, expiresAt
- Reservation: id, userId, quoteId, pickup/dropoff, locations, driver info, extras[], protection, status, holdAmount
- Rental: id, reservationId, vehicleId, odometerStart/End, fuelStart/End, damages, charges[], returnedAt
- Payment: id, objectId (reservation/rental), amount, currency, status, method, captured, refunded

Esempi rapidi
- Ricerca disponibilità
  GET /v1/availability?pickupLocationId=ROM1&dropoffLocationId=ROM1&pickupAt=2026-06-01T10:00:00Z&dropoffAt=2026-06-05T10:00:00Z&driversAge=30

- Creazione preventivo
  POST /v1/quotes
  {
    "pickupLocationId": "ROM1",
    "dropoffLocationId": "ROM1",
    "pickupAt": "2026-06-01T10:00:00Z",
    "dropoffAt": "2026-06-05T10:00:00Z",
    "classId": "SUV",
    "driversAge": 30,
    "extras": [{"id":"GPS","qty":1}],
    "promoCode": "SUMMER10"
  }

- Creazione prenotazione
  POST /v1/reservations
  {
    "quoteId": "q_123",
    "userId": "u_456",
    "driver": {"firstName":"Luca","lastName":"Rossi","licenseNumber":"ABC12345","licenseCountry":"IT","birthDate":"1992-04-10"},
    "paymentMethodId": "pm_789"
  }

Errori standard
- 400 validation_error, 401 unauthorized, 403 forbidden, 404 not_found, 409 conflict, 422 unprocessable_entity, 429 rate_limited, 500 internal_error
- Body errore: { "error": { "code": "validation_error", "message": "...", "details": [...] } }

Sicurezza e ruoli
- Ruoli: customer, agent, manager, admin
- Limitare operazioni di flotta/pagamenti a ruoli appropriati
- Mascherare dati carta (PCI), usare token PSP

Se vuoi, posso generare uno schema OpenAPI 3.0 a partire da questa struttura.
